subject: An error when dredging gdistsamp models

messages.author: 3cc57783657c133b
messages.subject: An error when dredging gdistsamp models
parts:
Dear unmarked list,

 

I am trying to use pdredge() or dredge() functions included in MuMIn package with gdistsamp() function of Unmarked. I am aware that dredging functions are not part of ‘unmarked’. However, as I can see from earlier posts in this list, many of unmarkers widely use these functions.

The global model fits ok:

> fgd.global <- gdistsamp(~Ziemaji+Vasaraji+Vagas+Zalaji_visi+P_211+P_221+P_511+Intensity_total+AR2000_PLAND+AR2000_CPLAND+STUDYAREA-1, ~Uzskaites_nr-1, ~Vējš, uFGDS, keyfun ="halfnorm", output=output, mixture=mixture, K=K, unitsOut=unitsOut)

When I try to generate a set of models with combinations of terms using pdredge() or dredge() so that I can choose later the best models,  I am getting an error stating that “’m1’ is not nested within ‘m2’”.

There are no NAs in the dataset and I set the variables in the Availability and Detection formulas as fixed so that only variables in the Abundance model vary:

> fgd.all <- pdredge(fgd.global, fixed = c("lambda(P_511)", "alpha(Uzskaites_nr)", "det(Vējš)"), m.lim = c(3, 5), clust, rank = AIC, extra = "adjR^2")

Fixed terms are "lambda(P_511)", "alpha(Uzskaites_nr)", "det(Vējš)" and "det(Int)"

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) :

  26 nodes produced errors; first error: 'm1' is not nested within 'm2'

 

I get a slightly different but very similar error also with dredge():

> fgd.all <- dredge(fgd.global, fixed = c("lambda(P_511)", "alpha(Uzskaites_nr)", "det(Vējš)"), m.lim = c(3, 5), rank = AIC, extra = "adjR^2")

Fixed terms are "lambda(P_511)", "alpha(Uzskaites_nr)", "det(Vējš)" and "det(Int)"

Error in matchCoef(fit1, all.terms = allTerms, beta = betaMode, allCoef = TRUE) :

  'm1' is not nested within 'm2'

 

Any ideas why “ 'm1' is not nested within 'm2'”?
